title: Witness 'Ed': $34B and $40B scrubbed from Air Force books
place_text: Nevada Test and Training Range; Edwards AFB; Pentagon

tellings.quote: So, I covered once a witness code named Ed who talked of a joint reverse engineering program between the Nevada Test and Trade Range and Edwards Air Force Base.

plain: Between about 2012 and 2016, $34 billion and then $40 billion were quietly wiped from the Air Force's books, and they paid for a joint reverse-engineering programme, an effort to study recovered craft and copy their technology, run between the Nevada Test and Training Range, a vast military range in Nevada, and Edwards Air Force Base. That is the account of a witness code-named "Ed," retold on the show by UAPGerb, an online researcher who once covered Ed's story. If true, it would show where hidden money for such work went.
